 Khaas 
 Safed chandan

 Now remove and strain instantly.

fullContent:
Lakshadi Taila (Oil) 
 Reference – Rasatantra Sar (first part); edition 13; 836 – 838. 
 Introduction 
 Lakshadi Taila (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This formulation is known to treat problems related with body aches and other ailments. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Pippali ki laakh 
 Soya 
 Asgandh 
 Haldi 
 Devdaaru 
 Renuka beej 
 Katuki 
 Murva 
 Kuth 
 Mulhathi 
 Nagarmotha 
 Lalchandan 
 Rasna 
 Padmaakh 
 Khaas 
 Safed chandan 
 Jatamaansi 
 Majeeth 
 Til oil 
 Curd water (buttermilk) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients in its appropriate quantity. Pippali bark up to 3840 gms, ingredients no. 2 to 18 up to 12 grams, til  oil up to 960 grams and buttermilk up to 3840 grams. 
 First of all take pippali bark, mixed in to 15360 grams water and prepare its kwath. 
 When one fourth water is left then remove from the flame and strain it. 
 Now add other ingredients in it and grind the mixture. 
 Now mildly cook in brassware pane till it reflects the oil content. 
 Now remove and strain instantly. 
 
 Dose 
 This is used externally. 
 Indications 
 
 Bodyache 
 Headache 
 Fever 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
